project.purpose: Own artifact construction, native-format validation, package assembly, evidence binding, trust gates, and artifact-specific durable delivery semantics without replacing mature format/tool owners.

nodes.label: ArtifactContract
nodes.responsibility: Bind requested artifact outcome, format family, acceptance, and evidence boundary.
acceptance: Artifact work is routed to an explicit family/acceptance boundary.

nodes.label: NativeBuildAdapter
nodes.responsibility: Compose replaceable mature writers/builders to produce native artifact bytes.
nodes.authority: Artifact domain orchestration; provider owns mechanics
acceptance: Builder/provider can be replaced without changing Artifact acceptance semantics.

nodes.label: ValidationEvidence
nodes.responsibility: Bind structural/native-consumer/semantic validation evidence to exact artifact outputs.
acceptance: Artifact acceptance is evidence-backed rather than inferred from file creation.

nodes.label: ArtifactIdentity
nodes.responsibility: Keep artifact/release identities and exact selected bytes/evidence references separate from transient build process state.
acceptance: Exact artifact output can be resolved independently of the builder process.

nodes.label: ArtifactObservation
nodes.responsibility: Record one production/capture observation with a generic producer reference while allowing content-version reuse.
acceptance: Two independent producers may reference the same content version without losing event identity.
nodes.nextAction: Pressure-test ProducerRef against PPTX, media, software-release, and dataset outputs before implementation.

slices.objective: Generalize artifact provenance from build output identity to Version + Observation + generic ProducerRef.
acceptance: A ProducerRef model works for at least four artifact families without importing Runtime/Media/Game semantics.
slices.nextAction: Run a cross-family model pressure test before changing code.

gaps: Artifact Version/Observation semantics are not yet declared as a universal cross-family contract in this repository.

review.notes: Initial project-native LEGO planning projection. It does not replace owner-native architecture or evidence.

sharedCatalog.note: Optional shared coordinates only; project-native semantics remain authoritative.
